name: AI21 Labs
description: Sign up and get a $10 trial, no credit card required. The credit is valid within 3 months. Includes Jamba Large and Jamba Mini models.

name: Alibaba Cloud Bailian (International Version)
description: After registration, each Tongyi Qianwen model will receive 1 million free tokens, valid for 90 days (international/Singapore area). No credit card required.

name: Cohere
description: Free "trial" API key, no credit card required. 1000 API calls per month. For non-commercial use only.

name: Mistral AI
description: Free "Experimental" plan, no credit card required. Approximately 1 billion Tokens per month. Cue words may be used to improve the model.

name: Zhipu AI
description: Offers forever free models, no credit card required.

name: Cerebras
description: Free, no credit card required. Extremely fast reasoning (about 2600 token/s). Daily limit of 1 million Tokens. Free file 8K context limit. llama3.1-8b is scheduled to be deprecated on May 27, 2026.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
description: 10,000 Neurons free every day. The free version offers over 50 models.

name: GitHub Models
description: Free prototyping credits for all GitHub users. Contains over 45 models. There is a limit on a single request (8K in / 4K out).

name: Groq
description: Free, no credit card required. Extremely fast LPU inference.

name: Hugging Face
description: Provide free users with a monthly inference service quota of 100,000 times. Routes to providers such as Fireworks, Together, Hyperbolic, Nebius, Novita, DeepInfra and more. Supports thousands of models.

name: Kilo Code
description: Free model, no credit card required. `kilo-auto/free` automatically routes to minimax/minimax-m2.5:free (80%) and stepfun/step-3.5-flash:free (20%).

name: LLM7.io
description: Seamless API gateway. No registration required for basic access. Supports more than 30 models. GDPR compliant.

name: ModelScope
description: Provides free API inference services to registered users. You need to bind your Alibaba Cloud account and complete real-name authentication.

name: Nebius
description: Sign up and get $1 in free credit, no credit card required. More than 60 open source models are available through an OpenAI-compatible API. Headquartered in the EU.

name: Nscale
description: Sign up and get $5 in free credit, no credit card required. EU sovereign provider with data center located in Norway. No rate limits, no cold starts.

name: Ollama Cloud
description: Free with qualitative usage limits. Offers over 400 models from the Ollama library. Not compatible with OpenAI SDK, use [Ollama API](https://docs.ollama.com/cloud).

name: OVHcloud AI Terminal
description: Free Anonymous Profile (no API Key, no registration required): Limit 2 RPM per model per IP. Hosting over 40 open source weight models in the EU. Compatible with OpenAI SDK.

name: Aion Labs
description: Free daily token quota, no credit card required. Designed for role-playing and story creation.

name: Agnes AI(Free forever)
description: The number of requests per minute is limited to 20. If the request is too fast in a short period of time, the frequency limit will be triggered (you need to wait 1 minute and try again)

models.name: Agnes 2.5 Flash
